# Best Areas to Stay in Pokhara, Nepal

## 🏆 **Lakeside (Most Popular)**
- The main tourist hub along **Phewa Lake**
- Packed with hotels, restaurants, bars, shops, and travel agencies
- Great for first-time visitors
- Divided into **Lakeside North** (quieter) and **Lakeside South/Central** (busier, more nightlife)

## 🌿 **Damside (Pardi)**
- Southern end of Phewa Lake near the dam
- **Budget-friendly** alternative to Lakeside
- Quieter and less touristy
- Close to the bus station

## 🏔️ **Sarangkot**
- Hilltop village with **stunning Annapurna & sunrise views**
- Best for a peaceful, scenic retreat
- Popular for paragliding launch point
- Limited dining options; more remote

## 🧘 **World Peace Pagoda Area**
- Very tranquil and spiritual
- Amazing panoramic views of the lake and mountains
- Limited accommodation options

## ✈️ **Airport Area / New Road (Prithvi Chowk)**
- Convenient for early flights or bus connections
- More local/authentic feel
- Less scenic

---

## Recommendations by Traveler Type:

| Type | Best Area |
|------|-----------|
| **First-timers** | Lakeside Central |
| **Budget travelers** | Damside |
| **Peace & views** | Sarangkot |
| **Nightlife & socializing** | Lakeside South |
| **Trekkers (pre/post trek)** | Lakeside North |

**Lakeside** is the best overall choice for most visitors due to convenience, variety, and lake views.
